title: List of Terminal Tools (A-Z) - Terminal Trove
content:
A
- abtop - Like btop, but for your AI coding agents.
- act - Run your GitHub Actions locally
- act3 - Glance at the last 3 runs of your Github Actions.
- ad - An adaptable text editor.
- adguardian-term - An AdGuard Home terminal monitoring tool.
- adsb-tui - A modern terminal user interface for tracking aircraft using ADS-B data.
- aerc - A pretty good email client.
- age - A simple, modern and secure file encryption tool.
- aic - Fetch the latest changelogs for popular AI coding assistants.
- aichat - all-in-one AI powered CLI chat and copilot.
- aider - AI pair programming in your terminal.
- aim - A command line download/upload tool with resume.
- ali - A load testing tool capable of performing real-time analysis.
- amdtop - A TUI system monitor specialized for AMD GPUs.
- amfora - A fancy terminal browser for the Gemini protocol.
- amp - A complete text editor for your terminal.
- amux - A TUI for easily running parallel coding agents.
- andcli - A 2FA TUI for your shell.
- angryoxide - A WiFi attack and pentesting tool built in Rust.
- apisnip - A TUI tool for trimming OpenAPI specifications down to size.
- aptui - A TUI package manager for APT-based Linux distributions.
- apw - A CLI for Apple Passwords (also known as iCloud Keychain)
- arduino-cli-interactive - An Interactive way to use the arduino-cli.
- aria2 - The ultra fast download utility.
- aria2tui - A TUI client for the aria2 download utility.
- artui - Read and track recent arXiv papers with a TUI.
- asak - A cross-platform audio recording/playback CLI tool with a TUI.
- asciinema - A terminal session recorder.
- asmdiff - A tool to compare per-function C assembly across compilers and revisions.
- asn - ASN lookup tool and traceroute server
- ast-grep - A CLI tool for code structural search, lint and rewriting.
- astroterm - A terminal-based star map.
- atac - A simple API client (postman like) in your terminal.
- atop - An advanced interactive monitor for linux systems.
- atuin - Sync, search and backup shell history.
- auggie - All the power of Augment Code in your terminal.
- austin-tui - The top-like text-based user interface for Austin.
- awsesh - A charming TUI for AWS SSO session management.
- az-tui - A TUI for managing Azure Container Apps.
B
- b4n - A terminal user interface (TUI) for the Kubernetes API.
- bacon - A background rust code checker.
- bagels - A powerful expense tracker that lives in your terminal.
- ballast - A tool for snapshot load testing APIs.
- bandwhich - Terminal bandwidth utilization tool
- basalt - A TUI for managing Obsidian vaults and notes.
- basilk - A TUI to manage your tasks with minimal kanban logic.
- bat - A cat(1) clone with wings.
- bbcli - A TUI and CLI for accessing BBC News in the terminal.
- bbrew - A Homebrew TUI Manager.
- bcal - Bits, bytes and address calculator.
- benben - A fast and efficient command line audio player and audio converter.
- bfs - A breadth-first version of the UNIX find command.
- bibiman - A simple TUI for handling your BibLaTeX database.
- binsider - Analyze ELF binaries like a boss.
- bit - Terminal ANSI Logo Designer & Font Library.
- bitchat-tui - A TUI client for bitchat.
- bkp - Utility that makes backups of your files/directories.
- blink - tiniest x86-64-linux emulator.
- bluetui - TUI for managing bluetooth on Linux.
- bluetuith - A TUI bluetooth manager for Linux.
- blueutil-tui - A TUI for macOS to interact with bluetooth devices via blueutil.
- bmm - Get to your bookmarks in a flash.
- bmon - Bandwidth monitor and rate estimator
- bombadillo - A non-web client for the terminal, supporting Gopher, Gemini and much more.
- bookokrat - A terminal EPUB / PDF ebook reader.
- boomtypr - A sleek typing test experience in the terminal.
- bottom - Yet another cross-platform graphical process/system monitor.
- bpftop - Dynamic real-time view of running eBPF programs.
- braindrop - A terminal-based client for raindrop.io.
- branchlet - Manage Git worktrees with automation from the terminal.
- broot - A new way to see and navigate directory trees.
- brows - A GitHub releases browser for the terminal
- browsr - A pleasant file explorer in your terminal supporting all filesystems.
- bt - Interactive tree-like terminal file manager.
- btop - A terminal monitor of resources.
- bttf - A CLI tool for datetime arithmetic, parsing, formatting and more. 
- bugstalker - A Modern Rust debugger for Linux x86-64.
- buku - Personal mini-web in text
- bullmq-dash - A TUI dashboard for BullMQ.
- byobu - Text-based window manager and terminal multiplexer
C
- calcure - Modern, customizable TUI calendar and task manager.
- calcurse - A calendar and scheduling application for the command line.
- caligula - A user-friendly, lightweight TUI for disk imaging.
- caps-log - A small TUI journaling tool.
- carbon-now-cli - generate beautiful images of your code from right inside your terminal.
- cargo-geiger - Detects usage of unsafe Rust in a Rust crate and its dependencies.
- cargo-seek - A TUI for searching, adding and installing cargo crates.
- cargo-selector - Cargo subcommand to select and execute binary/example targets.
- cariddi - A tool to crawl urls, scan endpoints, secrets, api keys, file extensions, tokens and more.
- carl - a cal(1) alternative calendar for the command-line.
- cashd - A fast and cozy TUI for personal finance management.
- castero - A TUI podcast client for the terminal.
- cava - Cross-platform Audio Visualizer for Alsa
- celerator - Monitor and debug celery tasks in the terminal.
- cgdb - A curses (terminal-based) interface to the GNU Debugger (GDB)
- chatuino - A feature rich TUI Twitch chat client.
- chawan - A TUI web browser.
- chdig - Dig into ClickHouse with TUI interface.
- chess-tui - Play chess from your terminal.
- chezmoi - Manage dotfiles across multiple machines.
- cheznav - A TUI for managing chezmoi dotfiles.
- chiko - A TUI gRPC client.
- chmod-cli - effortlessly generate chmod commands.
- chroncal - All in one calendar, tasks and journal manager in the terminal.
- cidr - A CLI to perform various actions on CIDR ranges.
- circumflex - It's Hacker News in your terminal.
- claude-code - An agentic coding tool that lives in your terminal, from Anthropic.
- claws - A TUI for AWS resource management.
- cliamp - A terminal music player inspired by winamp.
- climp - A minimal CLI media player.
- clin - A TUI note management app inspired by Obsidian.
- clipboard - Your new, ridonkulously smart clipboard manager.
- clipse - Configurable TUI clipboard manager for Unix.
- cloc - Count lines of code in many programming languages
- cloctui - A TUI interface for CLOC (Count Lines of Code)
- cloudflare-speed-cli - A terminal interface for cloudflare's internet speed tester.
- cmatrix - Matrix like effect in your terminal.
- cmdperf - Benchmark and compare shell commands interactively.
- cmus - Small, fast and powerful console music player for Unix-like operating systems.
- cobib - The Console Bibliography.
- codemark - Structural code bookmarks for humans and coding agents.
- coderabbit - Free AI Code Reviews in the CLI.
- codex - Lightweight coding agent that runs in your terminal from OpenAI.
- cointop - cryptocurrency tracking for hackers that like htop.
- colorstorm - A TUI to generate color themes for Vim, VSCode, and Sublime Text.
- comchan - A blazingly fast, minimal, and beginner-friendly serial monitor.
- concord - A TUI client for Discord with support for inline images.
- cooldeck - A keyboard first terminal dashboard for Coolify.
- cotp - trusted, encrypted, TOTP/HOTP authenticator with import functionality.
- countryfetch - A neofetch-like tool for fetching information about your country.
- cpufetch - Simple yet fancy CPU architecture fetching tool.
- cpx - A batteries-included Cargo-like CLI for C++.
- crates-tui - A TUI for exploring crates.io
- critique - A terminal UI for reviewing git diffs.
- croc - Easily and securely send things from one computer to another.
- croft - A VSCode-style TUI text editor.
- cronboard - A terminal tool for managing cron jobs locally and on servers.
- csvi - A simple cross-platform terminal CSV editor.
- csvlens - a csv viewer like less but made for csv.
- ctop - A top-like interface for container metrics.
- cueitup - Inspect messages in an AWS SQS queue.
- cull - Interactive TUI disk space analyzer.
- curl - A command line tool and library for transferring data.
- curlie - The power of curl, the ease of use of httpie.
- cy - A time traveling terminal multiplexer.
- cyme - List system USB buses and devices.
D
- daff - align and compare tables
- darya - A disk usage explorer with a TUI and live treemap.
- datui - Data Exploration in the Terminal.
- dawn - A distraction-free writing environment. draft anything, write now.
- daylight - Track sunrise and sunset times in the terminal.
- dblab - The database client designed for command line specialists.
- dcv - A TUI viewer for docker-compose.
- ddgr - DuckDuckGo from the terminal.
- ddv - A TUI to view Amazon DynamoDB in the terminal.
- deadbranch - Clean up stale git branches safely.
- dealve-tui - Delve into game deals from your terminal.
- deletor - Manage & delete files efficiently with an interactive TUI & scriptable CLI.
- delta - A viewer for git and diff output.
- depot - Replace docker build with depot build for up to 40x faster container image builds.
- depsguard - A CLI to harden package manager configs against supply chain attacks.
- desed - Demystify and debug your sed scripts, from the comfort of your terminal.
- devzat - A tool to chat over SSH.
- dhv - A TUI for visually exploring disassembled Python bytecode.
- diffnav - A git diff pager based on delta but with a file tree, à la GitHub.
- difftastic - A structural diff that understands syntax.
- diffyml - A fast, structural YAML diff tool with built-in Kubernetes intelligence.
- dijo - scriptable, curses-based, digital habit tracker.
- dirsearch - A web path scanner for finding hidden files and directories.
- diskbloom - A pastel, WizTree-style treemap disk visualizer that lives in your terminal.
- diskonaut - terminal disk space navigator.
- diskwatch - Single host disk diagnostics in your terminal.
- dive - A tool for exploring each layer in a docker image.
- dns53 - Expose your EC2 quickly, easily and privately within a VPC.
- dnsglobe - A global DNS propagation checker for your terminal.
- dnspyre - A CLI tool for a high QPS DNS benchmark.
- docfd - TUI multiline fuzzy document finder.
- dog - A command-line DNS client.
- doggo - A command-line DNS client for humans.
- dolphie - Realtime MySQL health monitoring in the terminal.
- domain-check - A fast, powerful CLI tool for checking domain availability using RDAP and WHOIS.
- dooit - A TUI todo manager for the terminal
- dotbins - Keep updated binaries in your dotfiles.
- dotenvhub - A TUI to manage your .env files in the terminal.
- dotstate - A modern, secure, and user-friendly dotfile manager.
- doxx - A viewer for Microsoft Word .docx files in the terminal.
- dra - A command line tool to download release assets from GitHub.
- drft - A diff re/viewer and file tree viewer.
- dry - A Docker manager for the terminal.
- drydock - A live terminal dashboard for a fleet of Git repositories.
- dskditto - An ultra fast and easy duplicate file finder.
- dstask - A CLI TODO manager with git-based sync + markdown notes.
- dstp - Run common networking tests against any site.
- dte - A small, configurable console text editor.
- dtop - Multi-host Docker monitoring in the terminal.
- dtop (python) - A high-performance TUI for Docker container management.
- dua - View disk space usage and delete unwanted data, fast.
- ducker - A slightly quackers Docker TUI.
- duf - Disk Usage/Free Utility - a better 'df' alternative.
- dug - A global DNS propagation checker on your CLI
- dunk - Prettier git diffs in the terminal 🎨
- durdraw - Versatile ASCII and ANSI Art text editor for terminals.
- dusage - A command line disk usage information
